Sector: Consumer discretionary — Automobiles (Jeep, Ram, Peugeot, Fiat and 10 other brands; North America, Europe, South America, Middle East & Africa) · Calls: 1 · Latest: 2026-11-20

**Thesis.** Stellantis is priced at about EUR 9.4B, under 6% of revenue, as if adjusted operating margins stay near 3% for good; a recovery to 4.2% by 2029, below management's 5% for 2028 and about a third of the 2022-2023 operating margin, gives 2029 adjusted EPS of about EUR 1.39, worth about $6.59 at 4x with dividends, and $6.30 after weighting a 35% chance that cost inflation and cash burn keep margins near 2%.

**Variant view.** The market is pricing an AOI margin of roughly 2.5-3.1% held indefinitely (at 4-5.6x earnings): a modest step up from 2026's 2.0%, well short of the base's 4.2% by 2029, and fair only at about a 71% bear weight. The operating evidence is mixed but improving: AOI rose from EUR 0.63B to EUR 1.99B in the first nine months, North America's margin rose 340 bp in Q3, shipments are up 7% year to date, VCP savings are guided to double sequentially in Q4, and IFCF improved by EUR 2.4B year to date. At EUR 3.23 a share the stock is worth about 2.3x the base case's 2029 EPS and 0.17x book value excluding the hybrids. The plan does not need to be met: a recovery to 4.2% is enough for about 86% upside by 2029, while even the bear starts from EUR 42.7B of industrial liquidity, so the downside is a slow erosion of value rather than a forced recapitalization in the next two years.

**Catalysts.**

- FY2026 results and 2027 guidance (Around February 25, 2027 (estimated from the 2026-02-26 release))
- Maserati relaunch plan (December 10, 2026)
- Q1 2027 shipments and revenue (Around April 30, 2027)
- H1 2027 results (Around July 29, 2027)
- Credit rating actions (S&P BBB- negative outlook, Moody's Baa3 stable) (Any time; S&P outlook review typically within 6-24 months)
- Brampton plant sale to Roshel closes (subject to government and regulatory conditions) (By end-2026)

**Pre-mortem** (written at decision time).

- Raw-material and memory-chip inflation (Oddo BHF estimates EUR 2.2B gross for 2027 alone) absorbed most of the Value Creation Program; the 2027 AOI margin stayed under 2%, IFCF stayed negative and the 2028 targets were withdrawn. — watch: 2027 guidance below a 2.0% AOI margin or without positive IFCF; Q1 2027 AOI below EUR 0.6B
- S&P cut Stellantis to junk in 2027; funding costs for the industrial group and Stellantis Financial Services rose, liquidity fell below the 25% target, and the board raised equity or issued more hybrids at 8%+, diluting holders at the bottom. — watch: S&P downgrade or negative watch; industrial available liquidity below 25% of TTM revenue at a quarter end; new 424B5 or hybrid issuance
- North America did not recover: Jeep shipments kept falling (down 60k units year over year in Q3 2026), U.S. dealer stock stayed above 90 days, incentives rose, and tariffs and the $13B U.S. investment plan held North America margins near 3%. — watch: North America AOI margin below 3% in H1 2027; U.S. dealer stock above 350k units at end-2026
- Europe kept losing money: Chinese competition (including partner Leapmotor's own brands) and EU CO2 rules forced price cuts, Enlarged Europe stayed negative and the 800k units of capacity cuts brought restructuring charges that the adjusted figures leave out but the cash pays. — watch: Enlarged Europe AOI margin below 0% for H1 2027; restructuring costs above EUR 1B a year

**Kill criteria.**

- 2027 guidance (FY2026 results) drops the target of positive Industrial free cash flow in 2027 (check by 2027-03-15) — open
- H1 2027 Industrial free cash flow below -EUR 2.0B (check by 2027-08-15) — open
- S&P or Moody's rates Stellantis below investment grade, or industrial available liquidity falls below 25% of TTM revenue at a quarter end (check by 2027-11-15) — open
- A common equity offering or rights issue is announced (check by 2028-03-15) — open
- FY2027 AOI margin below 2.0% (check by 2028-03-15) — open

**Probability claims.**

- 55%: Stellantis's adjusted operating income for FY2026, as reported in its FY2026 results release, is at least EUR 3.0 billion. (resolves by 2027-03-15)
- 75%: Stellantis's Industrial free cash flows for FY2026, as reported in its FY2026 results release, are better (less negative) than -EUR 4.5 billion. (resolves by 2027-03-15)
- 45%: Stellantis's Industrial free cash flows for FY2027, as reported in its FY2027 results release, are positive. (resolves by 2028-03-15)
- 35%: Stellantis's adjusted operating income margin for FY2027, as reported in its FY2027 results release, is at least 2.5%. (resolves by 2028-03-15)
- 65%: S&P Global Ratings' long-term issuer credit rating on Stellantis N.V. is BBB- or higher on December 31, 2027. (resolves by 2028-01-31)
- 85%: Stellantis does not announce an offering of new common shares (including a rights issue) between 2026-11-20 and 2027-12-31. (resolves by 2028-01-31)

**What would change the view.**

- More bullish: 2027 guidance with positive IFCF and an AOI margin of 3% or more despite the cost inflation, or Q4 2026 AOI above EUR 1.5B
- More bullish: North America AOI margin back above 5% for a half-year, or insiders and Exor buying stock
- More bearish: 2027 guidance without positive IFCF, H1 2027 IFCF below -EUR 2B, or a junk rating
- More bearish: any common equity raise, or a dividend policy change that lowers the liquidity threshold to fund cash burn

**Independent review: grade C** (evidence 3, valuation 4, variant view 3, risk 3, calibration 3). Counter-case: This is a Watch, not an Own. By the call's own reverse valuation, $3.54 already implies a 2.5-3.1% AOI margin held indefinitely, above the 2.0% the report estimates for 2026 and the 2.3% Visible Alpha consensus for 2027, so the market is not pricing 'no recovery'. The base then needs the margin to nearly double to 4.2% and industrial free cash flow (IFCF) to rise from zero to EUR 2.5B while the CEO says cost inflation runs through 2027 and probably 2028. The author gives only 45% to positive 2027 IFCF, the company's main near-term promise, and at 50/40/10 weights the value is $4.71 (10.0% a year, a Watch). The base's EUR 0.43 of dividends depends on liquidity staying above a 25% floor it now clears by one point (26%), industrial net cash excluding the hybrids is about EUR 0.5B, and the median of the five latest named targets is $3.84.

**Response.** Second round; the first round was also a C, and its fixes (base 2027 margin at the 2.3% consensus, bear exit cut to 4x, benefit liabilities in the cash cross-check, hybrid coupons) stand. Fixed in this round: the projection now shows the 2.3% base margin, the bear at 4x, financing costs of EUR 1.0-1.2B and the -$2.33 cash value; the report's Weighted column is $0.44 / $2.97 / $2.90 = $6.30; the chip-shortage wording now says it disrupted Fiat output; the EUR 2-3B inflation figure is replaced everywhere by Oddo BHF's sourced EUR 2.2B gross for 2027; the variant view, Section 7 and Section 13 now say the price implies a 2.5-3.1% margin held indefinitely, a modest step up from 2026's 2.0% and fair only at about a 71% bear weight; the early-warning thresholds now separate base from bear (guide below 2.0% is the bear signal, at or above the 2.3% consensus supports the base, 3%+ points to the bull, H1 2027 margin 2.0%+ confirms the base); the 2.5% margin claim is cut from 45% to 35%; the Unifor item now says only that Stellantis remains prepared to negotiate, and the Brampton catalyst is the sale closing; the 52-week high is $10.89 (2025-12 month-end close). Not accepted: a Watch now. The stance follows the rule at the stated 35/45/20 weights; the 50/40/10 sensitivity ($4.71, a Watch) is in the report, the position is labeled small and high-variance, and the first kill criterion (2027 guidance dropping positive IFCF, around February 25, 2027) moves the call to Watch. The 2028 step-up to 3.6% is still below the company's 5% target for that year, and the base value sits within 2% of its own cash cross-check ($6.44).

**Data notes.** Price is the 2026-11-19 committed close. StockAnalysis shows a 2026-11-20 close of $3.34 (-5.65%), not yet in the committed series; at $3.34 the weighted value implies 23.6% a year. Financials are IFRS in euros and the NYSE price is in dollars; every value converts at the 2026-11-19 EUR/USD close of 1.0972 and holds it constant. A 10% weaker euro by 2029 would cut every dollar value by 10%. Adjusted net income deducts a recurring EUR 0.4-0.7B allowance for restructuring and other unusual items that the company's adjusted EPS leaves out, so base EPS (EUR 0.52 in 2027) sits below the Street's adjusted EUR 0.90 on similar AOI. Sensitivity: each 1x of exit P/E is worth about $1.53 a share in the base (EUR 1.39 x 1.0972); each 0.5 point of 2029 AOI margin on EUR 175B is about EUR 0.22 of EPS, about $0.96 at 4x. Exit multiples: python3 -m capital.multiples cannot compute Stellantis's own bands (IFRS facts in euros against dollar prices) and its SIC 3711 group has only GM and Ford as captured peers, so it falls back to SIC 37xx (aircraft makers). Manual checks: Stellantis traded at 2.5x 2022 EPS (EUR 5.31, $14.20 at end-2022), 3.6x 2023 EPS (EUR 5.94, $23.32 at end-2023) and 6.8x 2024 EPS (EUR 1.84, $13.05 at end-2024) at year-end EUR/USD rates of about 1.07, 1.10 and 1.04; GM's ten-year P/E median is 6.4x (p25 5.6x) and Ford's 6.7x (p25 5.6x). The 4x base and bear exits are below both peers' 10th percentiles (4.9x and 4.8x). Hybrid perpetual notes (EUR 4.9B, March 2026) are equity under IFRS and inside industrial net cash, but rank ahead of common shares; the coupons (about EUR 0.26B after tax) are deducted from net income here, as the company does in EPS. Employee benefit liabilities (EUR 5.0B at September 30, 2026) are carried in the base through net financial expense rather than as a separate deduction. Street targets: the StockAnalysis aggregate (mean $6.39, low $3.92) says it was last checked November 9 and lags individual November targets (RBC and Oddo BHF at $3.29, Bank of America $3.84); the mean is probably stale on the high side.
